why: Owner never-touch lists for bin/worktree-clean. A repo key matches the main checkout's folder name or origin's repository name. A name pattern matches the branch or any folder on the worktree's path. ~/.config/nadavai/worktree-clean.json can add to these lists, never remove from them. On 2026-11-01 the tool removed 38 ~/Desktop/tf-513-* worktrees from the TherapyFlow owner's list.
